name: What proof should I ask for before hiring a shower tile installer?

mainEntity.name: What proof should I ask for before hiring a shower tile installer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ask about the waterproofing system, flood testing, tile substrate, and workmanship warranty before hiring anyone. A tile shower can look great on day one and still fail later if the installer skips proper waterproofing or slope control.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ask for details on waterproofing, flood testing, and warranty coverage. You want clear proof that the shower will be built to prevent leaks, not just look good.
